title: Activity row contract case
description: One Activity row rule web, the app and the server must agree on: the per-row position rule (a served row plus live messages, answers and reads, and whether the row is re-read) the unread predicate (does a live message count for this viewer), or how a sync inbox_row change applies to a held row. See README.md in this directory.

formatVersion.description: Version of this format. A loader skips (and reports) a case whose version it does not know.

id.description: Same as the file name without `.json`.

rule.description: position: the per-row position rule (given.row, steps, expect.row/reread). predicate: the unread predicate (given.viewer/scope/message, no steps, expect.verdict). sync_inbox_row: GET /api/sync/changes inbox_row changes on a held row (given.row; an upsert is an `answer` step, a delete a `syncDelete` step; expect.row/reread/removed).

why.description: Why the rule is what it is, in a sentence or two.

status.description: `agreed`: `expect` is the rule. `pending-product-decision`: the sides differ and nobody has chosen yet; `decision.candidates` records each candidate and loaders skip-and-report the case.

sources.description: Where each side implements the rule today (paths, optionally with symbols). Documentation only.

knownGaps.description: An agreed rule a side does not follow yet. That side's loader skips the case and reports the reason.

steps.description: Acts in order. Always empty for a predicate case.

checkpoints.description: Expectations part-way through (after a given step). Position cases only.

seq.description: A message seq (messages.seq, a 64-bit bigserial) as a canonical decimal string, as the server sends latestActivitySeq. Loaders compare seqs exactly (BigInt / Long), never as floating-point numbers.

followUp.description: Task or PR that closes the gap.

row.description: A served Activity row's unread inputs, as an inbox answer carries them.

position.description: The row's latestActivitySeq (a decimal string): the highest seq this answer counted. null: the server could not pair it with the row's latest message; the row takes no live patches.

mentionOnly.description: A mention with nothing else unread; the position is the highest mention seq.

readSeq.description: Optional: the viewer's read position served with the row (its maxReadSeq). Merged as a read is: the row keeps the higher read seq (a Mark as Unread ceiling still holds).

row.description: Position cases: the row as the last answer delivered it (no seqs applied yet).

viewer.description: Predicate cases: who reads the Activity.

scope.description: Predicate cases: what the client knows about the row's conversation when the message arrives.

threadFollowed.description: Thread/task rows: the viewer follows it. Absent = true.

activityMuted.description: Channel/DM rows: the viewer muted the conversation's Activity (a live message is past the mute boundary). Absent = false.

readOnArrival.description: The client reads the message as it arrives (open at the bottom with the read saved, a read queued past it, a read hold). Absent = false.

message.description: Predicate cases: the live message's fields, as message:new carries them.

systemSubtype.description: null: no subtype. Absent: the event did not carry the system provenance.

oneOf.description: A live message of the row's conversation arrives, with the unread predicate's verdict for it.

counts.description: The predicate's verdict. null: cannot be judged (re-read).

moves.description: The predicate's moves (absent = true). false: not the row's activity (past a channel or DM mute, no mention of the viewer); the row stays as it is.

oneOf.description: An inbox answer arrives with this row (a list read or a single-row re-read).
The viewer's read of the conversation up to seq is applied (a persisted read, or a read change's refSeq).
The viewer marks the conversation unread (the read cursor moves back): the row's read seq is cleared and kept as a ceiling a later read must pass to raise it again.
sync_inbox_row only: a GET /api/sync/changes inbox_row delete arrives. It removes the row when position is null or at or past the row's shown position; below it, the row is kept.

rowState.description: What the row shows after the step. Only the listed keys are asserted. position: the row's shown latestActivitySeq (the delivered one, or the highest seq applied above it).

reread.description: Some step since the case started asked to re-read this one row (not which request; never the list).

removed.description: sync_inbox_row only: the row is no longer held (a syncDelete applied). With true, `row` is not given.

counts.description: One more unread on the row. null: cannot be judged from the event (the row is re-read).

mention.description: It @-mentions the viewer: the row's @ lights.

moves.description: It becomes the row's latest activity (position, preview, order). false only past a channel or DM mute without a mention of the viewer: the server keeps the row at its last message before the mute.

reread.description: Some step up to this one asked to re-read the row.

removed.description: sync_inbox_row only: the row is no longer held after this step.

currentBehaviourOf.description: The sides that behave like this today.
